campaigns.context: Over 400 Binance typosquat domains and typedream.app subpages spoof Ledger, Trezor, and Bybit via wallet-setup paths. Random-label bin* domains such as binancee2.com and biiusd.com form the bulk of the infrastructure alongside PaaS-hosted lure pages. Reporters phishunt_io and skocherhan flagged 403 IOCs between 2026-08-14 and 2026-08-19.
campaigns.name: Crypto phishing targeting Binance, Ledger, Trezor and Bybit

campaigns.context: Operator-registered .com domains with 0149-prefix numeric labels (014901490149*.com and www0149*.com) host hundreds of Baidu-string subdomains. Subdomain patterns embed the string baidu2026 and date stamps, converging on IP 43.251.57.99. The consistent naming and shared infrastructure point to a single operator running a Chinese lottery or gambling scam network.
campaigns.name: Baidu-labeled subdomain wave on 0149-prefix .com domains

campaigns.context: Over 180 fake Telegram name-variant domains across .com.cn and .com TLDs impersonate Telegram to deliver a fake 'Telegram Security Center - Critical Patch' lure. Domain names combine teleg/telegram strings with phoneme variations (teleggrram, telegramip, zhifeijipc) and a mix of Chinese-market and generic TLDs. One reporter flagged the bulk of the IOCs on 2026-08-04.
campaigns.name: Telegram Security Center phishing on lookalike domains

campaigns.context: Random three-letter paired subdomains under mybluehost.me and posmasters.lk abuse compromised hosting accounts to distribute Google-themed phishing lures at scale. The uniform two-to-three-level structure (e.g. alz.rgg.mybluehost.me) suggests automated provisioning by a single operator. One reporter flagged 98 combined IOCs on 2026-08-17.
campaigns.name: Google phishing on compromised subdomains at mybluehost.me

campaigns.context: Kimsuky (DPRK-linked APT) C2 spans dynv6.net, dynu.net, and dns.army DDNS alongside operator-registered .shop, .store, and .online domains such as dywkdfue.shop and nstlog.store. Auth-themed hostnames like login-accounts.dynv6.net and update-themed endpoints like datupdatesourcetool.online characterise the activity. A loader (geniex_crav.zip) resolves its true C2 via DNS and XOR decryption. Reporters flagged 84 IOCs between 2026-08-04 and 2026-08-30.
campaigns.name: Kimsuky APT C2 infrastructure on DDNS and custom domains

campaigns.context: ValleyRAT C2 infrastructure bucket covering 29 IPs, 19 MD5 hashes, and 33 SHA256 hashes attributed to this malware family via local enrichment. C2 IPs include 121.127.253.206 on CTG Server Limited (HK) and 156.251.16.29 used for PNG staging. No registered domain is present; grouping is based on malware family attribution rather than shared domain or URL patterns. Four reporters flagged indicators from 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-25.
campaigns.name: ValleyRAT C2 infrastructure - IPs and hashes

Browsable directories expose staged files across 26 DDNS domains. Two reporters flagged 57 IOCs between 2026-08-09 and 2026-08-17.
